g.text: Three entry points over one shared seam; graph, planner and evaluation stay offline
reached only from the :8083 challenge route
Where the layer boundary now sits
app/* serves :8081 while policy_* serves :8082 and :8083, so the two product paths share no runtime module.
policy_demo_graph.py is the only module that knows both layers: it projects the demo's pair and investigation
into typed nodes, while policy_dependency_graph imports nothing from the scenario layer. The challenge route
re-projects and re-plans per request, so the graph is reached but never stored. Arrows are the imports that
define a layer, not the full import graph.
Read from the import statements in backend/ and backend/app/ on 2026-10-30.
